info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Assets & Media Delivery
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Assets & Media Delivery.** Asset upload and management, folder organization and CDN integration.

get.summary: Get folder tree with nested children and asset counts

200.description: Root folders, name-ascending, with subfolders nested recursively under `children`. A folder whose parent is missing is treated as a root.

get.summary: Get flat list of all folders (useful for dropdowns)

200.description: All folders of the organization, name-ascending, each with its direct asset count and a compact parent reference.

201.description: The created folder row (no relations included).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get folder by ID with parent, children, and asset count

200.description: The folder with its parent reference, direct subfolders and counts.

patch.summary: Update folder name or move to a different parent

200.description: The updated folder row (no relations included).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete folder (fails if it has children or assets)

200.description: Acknowledgement that the folder was deleted.

get.summary: List assets with optional mime type and folder filters

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (higher limit for large-screen tile grids)

parameters.name: mimeType
parameters.description: Filter by MIME type prefix (e.g. image/)

200.description: Page of assets, each with its uploader and a compact folder reference. `url` is a signed URL when signed-URL delivery is enabled.

get.summary: Advanced asset search with text, filters, sorting, and pagination

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Filter by folder ID ("root" for unfiled assets)

200.description: Page of matching assets, each with its uploader and a compact folder reference. All filters are AND-combined; `q` matches filename, original name, title, description or an exact tag.

get.summary: Get asset type facets (images/videos/audio/documents/other counts)

200.description: Per-media-type counts plus the organization total count and size.

get.summary: Get popular tags across the organization

200.description: Tags used by the organization with their asset counts, most used first.

get.summary: Find assets not referenced by any content

parameters.name: olderThan
parameters.description: ISO date — only show unused assets created before this date

200.description: Assets with no usage records, oldest first (not paginated — capped by `limit`, default 50).

get.summary: Get storage usage stats (CE: 5 GB limit)

200.description: Bytes and asset count used, with the plan quota (null when unlimited).

post.summary: Reconcile storage vs DB for this org: quarantine old orphans, flag missing files (IMP-ASSET-07)

200.description: Reconciliation report. All counters are zero and `slug` is empty when the organization no longer exists.

get.summary: Get asset by ID with upload info, folder, and content references

200.description: The asset with its uploader, full folder row and every content field that embeds it.

patch.summary: Update asset metadata or move to folder

200.description: The updated asset row (no relations included). Moving to a folder also appends the asset to the end of the manual order in that folder.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete asset and file (emits asset.beforeDelete — Pro plugins can prevent)

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Set to "true" to bypass usage check

200.description: Acknowledgement that the asset row was deleted. Storage cleanup is best-effort and never fails the response.

post.summary: Upload asset file (CE: 5 GB total storage limit, 50 MB per file)

201.description: The created asset. When an identical file already exists in the organization the existing asset is returned instead (content-addressable dedup, IMP-ASSET-08) — the envelope then also carries `deduplicated: true` next to `data`.

post.summary: Upload up to 50 files in one request — per-file success/error results

200.description: One result per uploaded file, in request order. A per-file failure is reported in that entry rather than failing the request.

post.summary: Bulk asset action (move / delete / addTags / removeTags) — per-item results

200.description: One result per requested asset id, in request order. Individual failures (e.g. a still-referenced asset on `delete`) do not fail the request.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

put.summary: Update asset metadata (title, description, alt, custom)

200.description: The updated asset row (no relations included). Omitted fields are left unchanged.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Add tags to an asset (merges with existing)

201.description: The updated asset row with the merged tag list (lower-cased, trimmed and deduplicated).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The updated asset row with the remaining tags. Unknown tags are ignored.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get which content items reference this asset

200.description: Usage count and the referencing content items; `usedIn` is empty when the asset is unused.

get.summary: Check if asset can be safely deleted (not referenced by content)

200.description: Whether deletion is safe, plus the number of remaining references.

put.summary: Reorder assets by updating sort_order values

200.description: Acknowledgement that the new order was persisted.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get CDN configuration status

200.description: Effective CDN configuration of this instance. `cdnUrl` is null and delivery uses direct storage URLs while CDN is disabled.

get.summary: Resolve CDN URL for an asset with optional transforms

200.description: The delivery URL with the requested transform params appended, plus the storage key it was built from. Signing only applies when a signing key is configured.

post.summary: Batch-resolve CDN URLs for multiple assets

201.description: Map of asset UUID to delivery URL. Ids that do not exist in the organization are simply absent; an empty `assetIds` array yields an empty object.

get.summary: Get responsive image srcset and picture sources for an asset

200.description: Everything needed to render a responsive `<picture>`: the base URL, a width-ladder srcset, and one source descriptor per requested format and breakpoint.

get.summary: Get all available image preset definitions

200.description: The eight built-in presets, keyed by preset name.

get.summary: Get a preset-optimized URL for an asset

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: Preset name (thumbnail, small, medium, large, xlarge, full, og, avatar)

200.description: The URL carrying the width/height/quality of the named preset. An unknown preset name falls back to the untransformed URL.

post.summary: Invalidate CDN cache for a specific asset

201.description: How many storage keys were submitted and which provider handled it. Returns `{ invalidated: 0, provider: 'none' }` when CDN delivery is disabled.

post.summary: Invalidate CDN cache for specific storage keys

201.description: How many storage keys were submitted and which provider handled it. Returns `{ invalidated: 0, provider: 'none' }` when CDN delivery is disabled or no keys were given.

delete.summary: Purge entire CDN cache (admin only, use with caution)

200.description: Whether a purge was issued and by which provider. Returns `{ purged: false, provider: 'none' }` when CDN delivery is disabled.

get.summary: Get all configured edge cache rules

200.description: The built-in cache rules in match order — the first pattern that matches a path wins.

get.summary: Preview Cache-Control headers for a given path

200.description: The headers that would be sent for this path and which rule produced them. Paths matching no rule yield `Cache-Control: no-store` and `info.rule: null`.

get.summary: Get recommended Cache-Control headers for an asset

200.description: The recommended cache headers for this asset, derived from its MIME type.

Headers that would be sent for this path — always `Cache-Control`, plus any extras the matched rule adds. Unmatched paths yield `no-store`.

info.description: Which rule matched and its effective TTL

cached.description: True when a rule matched and its TTL is greater than 0

ttl.description: Effective TTL in seconds; 0 when no rule matched

rule.description: The matched rule; null when no rule matched the path

pattern.description: Glob-style path pattern (`*` = one segment, `**` = any depth)

headers.description: Extra response headers emitted alongside Cache-Control

ttl.description: max-age of the matched rule in seconds

height.description: Target height in pixels; omitted for width-only presets

invalidated.description: Number of storage keys submitted for invalidation; 0 when CDN delivery is off

provider.description: Provider that handled the request; 'none' when CDN delivery is off

media.description: Media query for this `<source>`; omitted for the widest fallback source

url.description: Preset-optimized delivery URL for the asset

preset.description: Preset that was applied (echoed from the path; unknown names yield the plain URL)

cdnEnabled.description: False when CDN delivery is off (URL is the direct storage URL)

purged.description: False when CDN delivery is off, so nothing was purged

provider.description: Provider that handled the purge; 'none' when CDN delivery is off

url.description: Delivery URL for the asset, with any transform params appended and optionally HMAC-signed

cdnEnabled.description: False when CDN delivery is off — the URL is then the direct storage URL

storageKey.description: Storage key the URL was built from

url.description: Base delivery URL of the asset (no transform params)

srcset.description: Single srcset across the 320/640/1024/1600/2400 width ladder

sources.description: One `<picture><source>` descriptor per requested format and breakpoint (three per format: ≤640px, ≤1024px, and an unconstrained fallback)

cdnEnabled.description: False when CDN delivery is off (URLs are direct storage URLs)

enabled.description: Whether CDN delivery is switched on (`CDN_ENABLED`)

cdnUrl.description: CDN base URL (trailing slashes stripped); null while CDN delivery is off

signingEnabled.description: Whether an HMAC signing key is configured for signed URLs

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

errors.description: Present on 422 content-validation failures: one entry per rule that failed. Absent otherwise.

path.description: JSON pointer to the offending field

keyword.description: The rule that fired, e.g. required, after_field, before_field, requiredIf, requiredUnless, asset_exists, reference_exists

items.description: Array of items with their new sort order

metadata.description: Asset metadata (alt text, caption, credit, focal point, etc.)

folderId.description: Move asset to a different folder

parentId.description: Move to a different parent folder (null = root)
